function PrintChart() {
  const [chartType, setChartType] = React.useState<ChartType>('scatter');
  const apiRef = useChartProApiRef<ChartType>();

  const handleChange = (event: SelectChangeEvent) =>
    setChartType(event.target.value as ChartType);

  return (
    <Stack sx={{ width: '100%', display: 'block' }}>
      <Stack
        direction="row"
        sx={{ width: '100%', gap: 2, justifyContent: 'center', mb: 1 }}
      >
        <FormControl sx={{ minWidth: 200 }}>
          <InputLabel id="chart-type-label">Chart Type</InputLabel>
          <Select
            labelId="chart-type-label"
            id="chart-type-select"
            value={chartType}
            label="Chart Type"
            onChange={handleChange}
          >
            <MenuItem value="scatter">Scatter</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="line">Line</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="bar">Bar</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="pie">Pie</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="heatmap">Heatmap</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="funnel">Funnel</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="radar">Radar</MenuItem>
            <MenuItem value="sankey">Sankey</MenuItem>
          </Select>
        </FormControl>
        <Button onClick={() => apiRef.current!.exportAsPrint()} variant="contained">
          Print
        </Button>
      </Stack>
      <Chart key={chartType} apiRef={apiRef} type={chartType} />
    </Stack>
  );
}

export function withCountryCodeAsName(
  geoData: ExtendedFeatureCollection,
): ExtendedFeatureCollection {
  const nameToCode = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(countryData).map(([code, { worldAtlasName }]) => [worldAtlasName, code]),
  );

  // Seems like our world in data does not distinguish Somalia and Somaliland, but GeoJSON does.
  nameToCode.Somaliland = 'SOM';

  return {
    ...geoData,
    features: geoData.features.map((feature: ExtendedFeature) => {
      const name = feature.properties?.name;
      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
        return feature;
      }
      return {
        ...feature,
        properties: {
          ...feature.properties,
          name: code,
        },
      };
    }),
  };
}

      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
